output:
To: #announcements
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

@everyone charity stream is back. Saturday November 21, 10am to 10pm, live on my channel. Benefiting the Linden Community Pantry, which is serving around 340 families a week right now, and their shelves are the lowest they've been before Thanksgiving.

Goal is $600. Rook is matching the first $100 in donations, so the first 100 bucks counts double. Donate at lindenpantry.example/mrkz. Every dollar goes straight to the pantry, and through their wholesale partner $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food.

Last year we posted it way too late and got $212. This time it's up now so you have time to plan. Pin this, set a reminder, and tell your friends.

Incentives:
- $100: I play a full round with the controller upside down
- $250: chat picks my hair dye color and I do it on stream
- $400: one hour of only chat-picked songs, no skipping
- $600: I vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry

Game plan: first half is community lobbies, I'll drop the code on stream so anyone can jump in. Second half, chat votes on the game every 2 hours. No repeat maps, I promise Larry.

Can't donate money? You can still help. Canned and boxed food can go in the blue bin by the side door at the pantry, Saturdays 9 to 1. Or just show up, watch, and hype it up in chat, that counts too. Even $3 helps, and nobody should feel bad about what they can give.

Some of you think charity streams are cringe. Fair. Come roast me in chat all day, I'll take it. The pantry still gets the food either way.
